class.name: DataField
class.brief_description: One field of a [DataSchema]: a key, column or attribute of a data file.

method.name: set_enum_values
method.description: Sets [member hint] to [constant PROPERTY_HINT_ENUM] and [member hint_string] to [param values] joined with commas. A [String] field then accepts only these names; an [int] field accepts their values (0, 1, 2, ..., or the values given as [code]"Name:5"[/code]).

method.name: set_range
method.description: Sets [member hint] to [constant PROPERTY_HINT_RANGE] and [member hint_string] to [code]"min,max,step"[/code]. Numbers outside [param min] and [param max] are reported as [constant DataValidation.ISSUE_KIND_OUT_OF_RANGE]. Add [code]or_greater[/code] or [code]or_less[/code] to [member hint_string] to open a side of the range.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], an empty value ([code]null[/code] or an empty string, such as an empty CSV cell) is accepted and not checked further. If [code]false[/code], it is reported as [constant DataValidation.ISSUE_KIND_EMPTY_REQUIRED].

The value of an empty or unconvertible cell in the typed access of [CSV] ([method CSV.get_typed_row], [method CSV.get_typed_column]) and in [method DataSchema.convert_value], and the value written by [method CSV.append_typed_row] for a missing key.
A description of the field for people editing the data, for example as a tooltip in an editor.
For an [Array] field: the schema every element ([Dictionary]) is validated against. [member DataField.unique] fields of this schema are unique within the array.
For an [Array] field without [member element_schema]: the type every element must have ([constant TYPE_NIL] = any).

How [member hint_string] is read, as for an exported property. Validation uses [constant PROPERTY_HINT_RANGE] ([code]"min,max[,step][,or_greater][,or_less]"[/code]) and [constant PROPERTY_HINT_ENUM] ([code]"A,B:5,C"[/code]); editors can use any hint to build an editor for the value.
The details of [member hint], as for an exported property. See [method set_range] and [method set_enum_values].
The key, column name or attribute name of the field.

A regular expression (see [RegEx]) the whole value must match, as text, for example [code]"[A-Z]{2}[0-9]+"[/code]. Values that do not match are reported as [constant DataValidation.ISSUE_KIND_PATTERN_MISMATCH]. Empty means no check.
If [code]true[/code], a missing key or CSV column is reported as [constant DataValidation.ISSUE_KIND_MISSING_FIELD].
For a [Dictionary] field: the schema its keys are validated against.

The type of the value ([constant TYPE_NIL] = any). Text values (CSV cells, XML attributes, plain INI values) are accepted if they convert: [int] and [float] as numbers, [bool] as [code]true[/code], [code]false[/code], [code]1[/code] or [code]0[/code], other types in the syntax of [method @GlobalScope.str_to_var] ([code]Vector2(1, 2)[/code]). An [int] field also accepts a [float] without fraction, as JSON numbers are floats. Only data types can be set: not [Object], [RID], [Callable] or [Signal].
If [code]true[/code], the value must differ in every row of a table or every entry of a list of records. Repeated values are reported as [constant DataValidation.ISSUE_KIND_DUPLICATE_KEY].
